title: Weathering Totems
description: Survival friendly weather controls through craftable totems.
body:
# 🌦️ Weathering Totems

**Weathering Totems** introduces **three craftable totems**, that when used get consumed to change the weather accordingly.

⚠️ Base totem texture from ConcernedApe's Stardew Valley ⚠️

## ⚙️ Installation

Download the .zip file, put it in your world's data pack folder and copy it into your resource pack folder as well.
Ingame use _/datapack_ to make sure it is enabled.

## 📁 Items

The data pack adds a **Rain Totem** ![Rain Totem texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbd277c6d007e231fe9ddd08544a4aec37eb4830.png), a **Storm Totem** ![Storm Totem texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29a6fa0961426b698d82b7524e88203cf61c0742.png), and a **Sun Totem** ![Sun Totem texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/164a54ae9a54438649693dff7ded67565ccd6f4b.png), which summon rainy, stormy or clear weather respectively.

## 🛠️ Recipes

### 🌧️ Rain Totem

![Crafting grid layout for the rain totem.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/736c1a72d4b5e24f196ac45c779b5c53675f5acb.png)

Materials required to craft a **Rain Totem**:
- 1 Log (of any type)
- 2 Lapis Lazuli
- 1 Raw Fish (of any type)
- 1 Kelp

The recipe unlocks automatically after acquiring either a raw fish, kelp, or any other weather totem.

### ⛈️ Storm Totem

![Crafting grid layout for the storm totem.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38a0ad6f6ff200891021d2aeaabcecfb25d4e48f.png)

Materials required to craft a **Storm Totem**:
- 1 Log (of any type)
- 2 Lapis Lazuli
- 1 Lightning Rod (of any type)
- 1 Wind Charge

The recipe unlocks automatically after acquiring either a lightning rod, a wind charge, or any other weather totem.


### ☀️ Sun Totem

![Crafting grid layout for the sun totem.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66552ce251833dadee06cb6529ccf51671cc7fe6.png)

Materials required to craft a **Sun Totem**:
- 1 Log (of any type)
- 2 Lapis Lazuli
- 1 Sunflower
- 1 Glowstone Dust

The recipe unlocks automatically after acquiring either a sunflower, glowstone dust, or any other weather totem.

## 🔧 Configuration

By typing 
```
/function weto:config
```
you can change the duration a totem changes the weather for between preset alternatives. Options are [undefined], [1 min], [3 min], [5 min], [10 min] and [20 min].

[undefined] omits any duration from the /weather command, which means minecraft will change the weather at its own pace again.

[5 min] is the default setting.

## ⚠️ Troubleshooting

If you encounter any missing textures, make sure you **have copied the same .zip file into your resource pack folder and activated it**.
